description: This file implements a client-side API for managing real-time streaming cards in Feishu, including token management, card creation, content updates, and session control.

classes.name: FeishuStreamingSession
classes.description: Manages a streaming session for a Feishu card, handling creation, updates, and closure of the card with real-time text output.

methods.name: mergeStreamingText
methods.description: Merges previous and next streaming texts intelligently to avoid duplication and overlaps.

methods.name: resolveStreamingCardSendMode
methods.description: Determines the mode of sending a streaming card message based on options (reply, root_create, or create).
